title: 腾讯Dawson Tong：WorkBuddy如何靠开源模型突围？
speaker: Dawson Tong

segments.en: So, that's where we have been investing this year, starting in March, I would say.
segments.zh: 这就是我们今年从三月开始投入的方向。

segments.en: And after that, I think we see a lot of user adoption with the latest models, LLMs,
segments.zh: 之后，我们看到最新的大语言模型带来了大量用户采用，

segments.en: from the open-weight model players in combination with work buddy, integrated with document editing capabilities,
segments.zh: 来自开放权重模型提供方，结合工作助手，集成了文档编辑能力，

segments.en: browser-use capabilities, and we're able to build a much more user-friendly agentic products for our users.
segments.zh: 浏览器使用能力，我们能为用户打造更友好的智能体产品。
